QUOTE: "The library itself contains no thread creation." / "with the shipped defaults, the library runs no threads of its own and takes no locks."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library creates no threads by default, but it never says the pthread example compiles to a stub main under a default build. It lists `handle_ssl_connection` at `ssl_pthread_server.c:277` as a sample program entry point without saying that the file is stubbed out when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is off.
